+package main

+	"time"

+func main() {
+	// Simulate the issue we're fixing
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 1*time.Millisecond)
+	defer cancel()
+
+	// Create channels like in the dialConnection function
+	connChan := make(chan string, 3)
+	errChan := make(chan error, 3)
+
+	// Simulate multiple IPs - in the fixed version, these would check context
+	ips := []string{"10.0.0.1", "10.0.0.2", "10.0.0.3"}
+	
+	// Give context time to expire
+	time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
+	
+	// Simulate the fixed behavior
+	for _, ip := range ips {
+		go func(ip string) {
+			select {
+			case <-ctx.Done():
+				errChan <- ctx.Err()

+				connChan <- fmt.Sprintf("connected to %s", ip)
+			}
+		}(ip)
+	}
+
+	// Collect results
+	for i := 0; i < len(ips); i++ {
+		select {
+		case conn := <-connChan:
+			fmt.Printf("Got connection: %s\n", conn)
+		case err := <-errChan:
+			fmt.Printf("Got error: %v\n", err)
+		}
+	}
